verdict.rationale: Thoropass says it collects compliance-relevant data automatically through auditor-vetted native integrations, and that this data automatically satisfies evidence requests. Monitors check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP, and access-review evidence gathering is also automated. All of this comes from vendor docs and marketing only. Missing for 10: documented collection schedule/cadence, explicit timestamping of collected artifacts, explicit replacement of screenshots/CSV uploads, independent or hands-on corroboration.
